hypothesis: Extend the two previously frozen BB reversal alternatives and original baseline to six calendar years without any rule or threshold change. BB2 recovery tests exhaustion; W/M tests weakening second extremes. Persistent trends, late confirmation and costs can invalidate both.
baseline: Unchanged original BB3 reversal candidate/execute functions
entry_rules: Exactly the inherited specification and existing research_bb_alternatives functions: BB2 previous close outside corresponding band then current close inside both; W/M strict close pivots left2/right2, later more extreme close inside both bands, intervening SMA rebound, confirmed neckline close break, expiry60, adverse secondpivot wick cancellation and gap reset. All buy/sell mirrored, next contiguous open, one position per pair. Original unchanged. No new filters, optimization or AI.

exit_rules.original_and_bb2: Fixed tick-rounded signal SMA20 target; stop=2entry-target; reward>=3pips at actual entry
exit_rules.wm: Secondpivot extreme plus outward one tick stop; TP=2entry-stop; risk>=3pips at actual entry. No trailing, timeexit or breakeven.

warmup: 2019-12-01; same cached-feature builder. Prior-year setups may create currentyear signals; independent books start flat with no prior pending orders.

periods.validation: Each calendar year 2020 through 2025, independent flat books
periods.final_confirmation: None: descriptive historical extension, not virgin holdout
periods.overlap: Separate flat 2023-01-01 through 2026-01-01 book for reconciliation with prior results

final_period_prior_exposure: 2023-2025 previously explored; prior exposure of 2020-2022 not certified unused. No development from these outcomes.
search_space: Exactly original, bb2_reentry and wm at RR1; 2 costs x 7 pairs x 8 books =336 simulations; one pass then stop.
data_rules: Read Bars.dat through existing HistoryRepository 5m aggregation; arithmetic epoch, unknown source timezone, chart OHLC not verified executable bidask. Check finite positive valid OHLC, strictly increasing times and annual coverage. No missing-bar fabrication; partially populated M5 source buckets kept as prior pipeline. Source SHA256 and before/after stats recorded. Compare 2023-2025 timestamps/OHLC/features/candidates against old frozen cache before simulation; explain or stop on differences.
cost_and_fill_model: Hypothetical combined roundtrip1pip, stress1.2pip, NOT historical GMO spread. Samebar SLfirst, gaps atopen; next entry bar exactly300seconds away. No extra swap/slippage. Fullcost included once in open MTM.
position_sizing_and_currency: Equal initial-riskR pertrade; combined lastknown closeMTM; pips descriptive equalpip score, not accountcurrency. No forced endexit; pending/open positions reported separately.
acceptance_gates: Both alternatives independently require EACH of six years >=100closed, RPF>=1.2, averageR>0, coststress netPlusOpenR>0, >=4of7positivepairs; sixyear continuous combinedMTMDD<=1.2original. Independent validation/completeness required. No selfadoption or Pine migration.
code_identifier: run_manifest hashes this and inherited spec, source, tests, shared features/engine/aggregation, Pine and newly generated cache; raw SHA in data manifest
jev_role: No new paid calls; prior code review only. No Jev trade decisions/cache reads.
